## Changes

Describe the map changes and their starting map revision.

## Requests resolved

Add one `Closes #NUMBER` line per fully addressed request, or state that no requests are resolved.

## Review

- [ ] JSON and PNG come from the same edited map.
- [ ] Manifest checksums match the files and record the correct base revision.
- [ ] Changes merged since editing began have been reconciled.
- [ ] Administrator has compared the old/new images and reopened the JSON in Rail Map Painter.

Merge is performed manually by the administrator.
